fields.headline: Power may be shut off Saturday evening to reduce wildfire risk
fields.message: Strong winds and very dry conditions are forecast. We may turn off power on your circuit to reduce the chance of a wildfire.
fields.powerOn: We expect power back by midday Sunday after crews inspect lines.
fields.circuits: Circuit C-114: Cinder Canyon and Ridgeview
fields.whatToDo: Charge phones and medical devices, fill prescriptions, fill your vehicle with fuel and plan for several days without power.
fields.medicalNote: If you rely on power for a medical need, call 555-0100 now. In an emergency call 911.
fields.resourceCenter: Calloway High School gym, 8 AM to 8 PM Sunday: charging, water, restrooms.

fields.headline: Power has been shut off to reduce wildfire risk
fields.message: We turned off power on your circuit at 6:04 PM because gusts reached 52 mph.
fields.powerOn: Power returns after the wind falls and crews inspect lines; we will update you.
fields.whatToDo: Treat downed lines as live. Use generators outdoors only.

fields.headline: Power is being restored to your area
fields.message: Winds have fallen and crews finished inspecting circuit C-114.
fields.powerOn: Restoration under way; most customers back by 1:00 PM.
fields.whatToDo: Turn off major appliances before power returns and turn them on one at a time.

fields.headline: Power shutoff canceled
fields.message: Winds are lower than forecast. We will not turn off power on your circuit now.
fields.whatToDo: Stay ready; conditions can change until the red flag warning ends.

fields.headline: All clear: the wildfire risk event has ended
fields.message: Power is back on for all customers and the red flag warning has ended.
fields.whatToDo: Report any outage that remains at 555-0100.
fields.resourceCenter: The community resource center has closed.
